attempts.diagnosis: The postcondition `ensures r >= -1 ==> x in elems` is too strong. On the `return -1` path, `r == -1`, so `r >= -1` is true and the postcondition requires `x in elems`. But the method returns -1 only when the loop has scanned all `nelems` elements without finding `x`, so `x` should not be in `elems`. The condition should be `r >= 0`, not `r >= -1`.
